title: PIDSS Production Records Schema
description: Schema descriptor for production_records.csv — the per-stage, per-period production log written by the C++ Simulator CLI. This JSON document defines the expected CSV column structure, types, and constraints. The CSV itself uses the columns listed below with a header row.

columns.description: Ordered list of CSV columns. All columns are required. Column order in the CSV must match this list.

columns.name: run_id
columns.description: UUID v4 of the run that produced this record.

columns.name: stage_id
columns.description: Stage identifier. For integrated WorkUnits, records are attributed per stage using pre-materialized stage_weights.

columns.name: work_unit_model_id
columns.description: WorkUnitModel that served this stage in this period.

columns.name: good_units_produced
columns.description: Quality-adjusted good units produced at this stage in this period (after defect deduction).

columns.name: defect_units
columns.description: Total defective units generated at this stage in this period.

columns.name: rework_units
columns.description: Units sent to rework at this stage in this period.

columns.name: scrap_units
columns.description: Units scrapped (defect minus rework) at this stage in this period.

columns.name: utilization
columns.description: Stage utilization fraction in this period (0.0–1.0).

columns.name: blocking_time_sec
columns.description: Cumulative blocking time in seconds for this stage in this period.

columns.name: starvation_time_sec
columns.description: Cumulative starvation time in seconds for this stage in this period.

columns.name: wip_at_boundary
columns.description: Average WIP units at this stage's output boundary at end of period.

columns.name: effective_availability
columns.description: Effective availability of the serving WorkUnit in this period (from MTBF/MTTR). 1.0 if no reliability data.

columns.name: effective_oee
columns.description: Effective OEE of the serving WorkUnit in this period.
